verdict.rationale: Qapita is a cap table and equity management SaaS platform, not an AI agent or assistant. Plugging in MCP servers so the product can call their tools is an MCP-client role, which is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Qapita shipping an AI agent or any MCP client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
